overview: A camera and film: take a picture of exactly what you see.
Develop it in a water cauldron, in a room lit only by redstone, and hang the print on a wall.

1.1.1: Mod Menu's Donate button leads to sponsoring the author on GitHub. Nothing in play changes.
1.1.0: Film is loaded into the camera: click film onto it in your inventory, as into a bundle. It holds 16 film, blank and exposed together.
Exposed film stays in the camera until you right-click the camera with nothing held to take it out.
Sneak and right-click a block to set the camera down, facing the way you look. Power it with redstone and it takes a picture through its lens.
Use film on a placed camera to load it, and an empty hand to take its exposed film out. Broken, it drops with its film inside.
A placed camera's picture is drawn by the nearest player's game, unseen; they need Pandorical 15.22 or later.
1.0.1: Light behind the solid side of a slab or stair no longer spoils a darkroom; the game does not let it through either.
A light that does spoil one is named with where it stands, so it can be found.
1.0.0: Craft a camera and film, and take pictures of what you see.
Develop the film in a water cauldron in a darkroom lit only by redstone light.
Let other light in while it develops and the film is lost.
Hang the photograph on a wall, two blocks by two.
